themes.description: Dynamic Material 3 Expressive UI derived from your wallpaper palette: Material Symbols, adaptive top bar, rounded dock, Cookie Clock, Control Center (Audio Mixer, Multi-Monitor, Wi-Fi/BT, Todo/Pomodoro/Calendar), Wallpaper & Clipboard pickers, Media popup, Session Screen, M3 OSD & Toasts.
